MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 14, 2024
  6201 APPIAN WAY
  LONG BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

Colin Kelly, Chair  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
Jo Murray, Vice Chair  Bruce Mac Rae, Commissioner
Avis Atkins McPhail, Commissioner  Theresa Marino, Commissioner
Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner  Sabrina Zavala, Commissioner
Gordana Kajer, Commissioner

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52385  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, February 8, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-52498  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Bluff Park Bluffs.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-52535  Recommendation to conduct a study session regarding Harborlight Marina.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-52386  Recommendation to endorse submission to approve a fee waiver for the Seal
  Beach Yacht Club (SLBYC), in an amount not to exceed $5,000.00, for use of dock
  space in Alamitos Bay Marina for visiting/participating vessels for Opening Day
  festivities on May 4, 2024; the Seal Beach to Dana Point Regatta on July 6, 2024
  and during the 2024 Marina Del Rey "Outlaw" Regatta on August 31, 2024. (District
  3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-52387  Recommendation to endorse the submission to approve a fee waiver for the Long
  Beach Yacht Club, in an amount not to exceed $8,250.00, for use of dock space in
  Alamitos Bay Marina for visiting/participating vessels during the 2024 Ficker and
  Congressional Cups for the period of April 18 - April 28, 2024 and the Long Beach
  Olympic Classes Regatta for the period of July 19 - 21, 2024. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-52476  Recommendation to endorse submission to approve a fee waiver for the Navy
  Yacht Club - Long Beach, in an amount not to exceed $5,000, for use of dock

  Page 1 of 2
   MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 14, 2024
  6201 APPIAN WAY
  LONG BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

  space in Alamitos Bay Marina for veteran honoring, racing and cruise celebrations,
  for the period of April 2024 through December 2024. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  24-52388  Recommendation to endorse the submission to approve a fee waiver for the Little
  Ships Fleet Yacht Club, in an amount not to exceed $5,000, for use of dock space
  in Alamitos Bay Marina for racing and cruise celebrations for the period of April 21,
  2024 through August 24, 2024. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  24-52389  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  24-52390  Recommendation to receive and file the Committee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau office at (562) 570-3215 by noon,
the day prior to the meeting.
